author: Bobby Grayson
title: All three blocked, none on a translator gap. (1) Loom.LSP.ConfigListener is a 20-line PubSub listener whose one blocker is Loom.LSP.Supervisor.start_from_config/0 -- it reads config and DynamicSupervisor.start_child's an LSP client per entry, so it SPAWNS; a no-op row would claim the process makes no effect where it starts processes. Its file also holds a use Supervisor module whose init/1 ends in Supervisor.init/2, which the translator reads as a GenServer init. (2) LoomWeb.CostDashboardLive: assign_metrics/1 calls Metrics.global_metrics/0, all_sessions/0, model_breakdown/0, tool_stats/0, each of which is a direct :ets.lookup into another process's table; ETS contents are outside the model by construction. (3) LoomWeb.TeamCostComponent: float literals, DateTime.diff/add bucketing and CostTracker.get_call_history/2.
